decisions.reason: It has remained on its own page for two years and, despite only vague market feedback, the evidence is not negative enough to justify closing this still-uncertain but relatively contained software option.
Its continued placement on the home page suggests strategic importance and traction, so management would likely keep investing in this low-uncertainty, core-adjacent platform.
A configurable managed hosting plan fits closely with a hosting-oriented information services business, and its continued dedicated presentation indicates enough promise to keep the option open.
As a 2024 add-on offer with limited but still current website presence, it is too early to abandon and likely inexpensive to keep on the market while demand becomes clearer.
